source_text: ΠΕΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΕΝ ΠΝΕΥΜΑΤΙ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΗΘΕΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΚΥΝΗΣΕΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΛΑΤΡΕΙΑΣ ΛΟΓΟΣ ΕΝΝΑΤΟΣ. Περὶ τῆς ἁγίας σκηνῆς, ὅτι τύπος ἦν τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἐκκλησίας. Ἀγάπης μὲν οὖν εἰς Θεόν τε καὶ ἀδελφοὺς περιφανῆ τὰ αὐχήματα, καὶ ἀποπεραίνεται μὲν δι' ἀμφοῖν
pass_a_gloss: Heading: Concerning (peri) the in-Spirit-and-truth worship (proskynēsis) and service (latreia), discourse (logos) nine. Concerning the holy tent (skēnē), that it was a type (typos) of the Church (Ekklēsia) in Christ. Of love (agapē) toward God and brothers (adelphoi) conspicuous (periphanē) [are] the boasts/glories (auchēmata), and is brought to completion (apoperainetai) through both [— subject ho nomos, 'the law', stands at the head of section 2].
pass_a_gloss_with_greek: Heading: Concerning (περί) the in-Spirit-and-truth worship (προσκύνησις) and service (λατρεία), discourse (λόγος) nine. Concerning the holy tent (σκηνή), that it was a type (τύπος) of the Church (Ἐκκλησία) in Christ. Of love (ἀγάπη) toward God and brothers (ἀδελφοί) conspicuous (περιφανῆ) [are] the boasts/glories (αὐχήματα), and is brought to completion (ἀποπεραίνεται) through both [— subject ὁ νόμος, 'the law', stands at the head of section 2].
pass_b_english: ON ADORATION AND WORSHIP IN SPIRIT AND TRUTH — BOOK NINE. On the holy tent: that it was a type of the Church in Christ. Love for God and for our brothers has glories plain for all to see, and through both of them the law is brought to its fulfillment (Matthew 22:37–40).

choices.why: σκηνή is rendered ‘tent’ to match Books 1–8 of this work and the old Book 9 heading.
Pass A sense kept in the reading text.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Cyril De adoratione Book 9 exists. Translated fresh from the PG 68 Greek on 2026-10-23; the earlier English of this book was not used as a base.

apparatus.note: PG OCR; column may cut mid-sentence.

The Greek sentence breaks across the row boundary: its subject ὁ νόμος (‘the law’) is the first word of section 2. To keep the reading natural, ‘the law’ is rendered here in section 1 and section 2 begins with the next sentence. The twin love of God and of the brothers that fulfils the law is cited to the double commandment (Matthew 22:37–40); Romans 13:8–10 is a possible second echo, not cited. σκηνή is rendered ‘tent’ to match Books 1–8 of this work and the old Book 9 heading.
